refuted_implication: A dimension-free lower bound on the aggregate squared principal 2x2 determinant bank of an exact scalar Schur residual forces one physical principal pair with determinant bounded below by a universal constant.
counterexample: For m>=3, S_m is the direct sum of m copies of J_m/m. Then s_2(S_m)=1 and the squared principal-pair determinant bank equals (m-1)/(2m)>=1/3, but every physical principal-pair determinant is 0 or 1/m^2, so the maximum tends to zero. Embedding A_m=[1] direct_sum S_m gives an exact target-class family. The full QFORM law is not a counterexample: disjoint block aggregation plus the source-pinned cap-one projection theorem gives density at most pi*e.
repair: Pay the S2 determinant bank collectively before reciprocal pair cost; do not select one pair. The run also proves a scalar-Schur second-compound overlap trichotomy and pays its diffuse disjoint-bank branch.
